title: Private Puerto Nuevo Tour with Minivan
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Discover the colorful culture and flavors of Baja California on this private full-day tour from San Diego. Visit the vibrant seaside village of Puerto Nuevo, renowned for its delicious lobster, and immerse yourself in the artistic vibes of Rosarito. Enjoy a guided tour of stunning street murals, connect with local artisans, and relish ample beach time. This exclusive tour includes round-trip private transportation, making it easy to unwind and take in the sights at your own pace. Indulge in a delicious lunch and local beer tasting, all while experiencing the laid-back coastal lifestyle of Baja.

- Full-day private tour with 8 hours of exploration
- Visit Puerto Nuevo for authentic Baja-style lobster
- Enjoy guided art walks and artisan market visits in Rosarito
- Includes round-trip private transportation and lunch
